```{r setup, include=FALSE}
source("rvis-setup.R")

# Sections of a guide: level-2 headings with an anchor {#id}, and the level-3 headings (plotters) under each
guide_sections <- function(file) {
  x <- readLines(file, warn = FALSE, encoding = "UTF-8")
  out <- list(); current <- NULL
  for (line in x) {
    if (grepl("^## ", line) && !grepl("^## Data", line)) {
      # a heading with an anchor {#id}, or without (pkgdown makes its id from the title)
      title <- trimws(sub("\\{#.*$", "", sub("^## ", "", line)))
      id <- if (grepl("\\{#[^}]+\\}\\s*$", line)) sub("^.*\\{#([^}]+)\\}\\s*$", "\\1", line) else anchor(title)
      current <- list(title = title, id = id, plotters = character())
      out[[length(out) + 1]] <- current
    } else if (grepl("^## ", line)) {
      current <- NULL
    } else if (!is.null(current) && grepl("^### ", line)) {
      out[[length(out)]]$plotters <- c(out[[length(out)]]$plotters, trimws(sub("^### ", "", line)))
    }
  }
  out
}

# pkgdown anchors of level-3 headings: lower case, spaces and punctuation as dashes
anchor <- function(x) gsub("^-+|-+$", "", gsub("[^a-z0-9]+", "-", tolower(x)))

guides <- c("comparing-categories" = "Comparing categories", "parts-of-a-whole" = "Parts of a whole",
            "relationships-distributions" = "Relationships and distributions", "time-series" = "Time series",
            "networks-hierarchies" = "Networks and hierarchies", "tables" = "Tables")
```

All examples of rvis in one place: the examples of every chart type, drawn by every plotter, in the
chart guides; and the example dashboards that come with the package.

## Chart examples

Each chart guide shows its chart types on one R data set, with an example for each plotter drawing
that type. The examples need the plotting package of their plotter; with the package installed, you
can copy and run them as they are.

```{r chart-index, echo=FALSE, results="asis"}
for (g in names(guides)) {
  secs <- guide_sections(paste0(g, ".Rmd"))
  secs <- Filter(function(s) length(s$plotters) > 0, secs)
  cat(sprintf("\n### [%s](%s.html)\n\n", guides[[g]], g))
  cat("| Chart | Examples by plotter |\n|:--|:--|\n")
  for (s in secs) {
    links <- sprintf("[%s](%s.html#%s)", s$plotters, g, anchor(s$plotters))
    cat(sprintf("| [%s](%s.html#%s) | %s |\n", s$title, g, s$id, paste(links, collapse = ", ")))
  }
}
```

The [chart type and plotter reference](chart-types.html) lists the wrapper functions of each chart
type with their arguments, and the [configuration reference](configuration.html) the settings of each
plotter. [Interactive charts](click-events.html) shows how clicks on charts become shiny inputs.

## Example dashboards

rvis comes with `r nrow(rvisDashboardExample())` example dashboards (YAML files in folder
`dashboards` of the package). List them with `rvisDashboardExample()`, and run one with
`runDashboard(rvisDashboardExample("<name>"))`:

```{r, eval=FALSE}
rvisDashboardExample()                              # name, group, title and file of each example
runDashboard(rvisDashboardExample("faithful"))      # runs one
file.edit(rvisDashboardExample("faithful"))         # opens its configuration, to copy and change it
```

They are in three groups:

- **[Gallery](dashboard-gallery.html)**: 20 apps of the [Shiny gallery](https://shiny.posit.co/r/gallery/)
  rebuilt from YAML, with a screenshot of each.
- **[Showcase](dashboard-gallery.html#showcase-dashboards)**: two large dashboards combining most features.
- **Basics**: small dashboards showing one feature each, explained in the dashboard guides.

```{r dashboard-index, echo=FALSE, results="asis"}
ex <- rvisDashboardExample()

# Where each example is shown: the guide (and section) whose code shows its YAML or screenshot
shown_in <- function(name) {
  for (f in list.files(".", pattern = "\\.Rmd$")) {
    x <- readLines(f, warn = FALSE, encoding = "UTF-8")
    hit <- grep(sprintf("(show_yaml|show_shot|example_section|rvisDashboardExample)\\(\"%s\"", name), x)
    if (length(hit) == 0) hit <- grep(sprintf("list\\(\"%s\",", name), x)
    if (length(hit) == 0 || f == "examples.Rmd") next
    heads <- grep("^## .*\\{#[^}]+\\}", x)
    heads <- heads[heads < hit[1]]
    page <- sub("\\.Rmd$", ".html", f)
    if (f == "dashboard-gallery.Rmd") return(sprintf("%s#%s", page, name))
    if (length(heads) == 0) return(page)
    return(sprintf("%s#%s", page, sub("^.*\\{#([^}]+)\\}.*$", "\\1", x[max(heads)])))
  }
  NA_character_
}
pages <- c("dashboard-gallery.html" = "gallery", "dashboard-reference.html" = "item reference",
           "dashboard-layouts.html" = "layouts", "dashboards.html" = "getting started",
           "dashboard-extensions.html" = "Shiny packages", "click-events.html" = "interactive charts")

for (grp in c("basics", "gallery", "showcase")) {
  e <- ex[ex$group == grp, ]
  cat(sprintf("\n### %s\n\n", c(basics = "Basics", gallery = "Gallery", showcase = "Showcase")[[grp]]))
  cat("| Example | Title | Shown in | Run it |\n|:--|:--|:--|:--|\n")
  for (k in seq_len(nrow(e))) {
    where <- shown_in(e$name[k])
    shown <- if (is.na(where)) "" else sprintf("[%s](%s)", pages[[sub("#.*$", "", where)]], where)
    cat(sprintf("| `%s` | %s | %s | `runDashboard(rvisDashboardExample(\"%s\"))` |\n",
                e$name[k], e$title[k], shown, e$name[k]))
  }
}
```
